enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Pull blanket over body. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Wash hands. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Put bowl in dishwasher. Open dishwasher. Place bowl inside. Close dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Get dressed and prepare for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check bag for items. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Work as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Put on scrubs. Check schedule. Walk to patient room. Talk to patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Walk to nurses' station. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Walk back to work area. Attend meeting. Talk to doctor. Walk to patient room. Check on patient. Update records.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open music app. Put on headphones. Play music. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Get pot and place on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type. Save document. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Walk to bed. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
